# Sulfur Springs Land Management

> Sulfur Springs Land Management is a veteran-owned referral service, not a licensed contractor. It connects landowners in the **Sulphur Springs Valley of Cochise County, Arizona** — Willcox, Cochise, Pearce, Sunsites, Dragoon, Kansas Settlement, Bowie, San Simon, Elfrida and McNeal — with independent, ROC-licensed local contractors for land clearing, grading, building pads, driveways, trenching, bulk debris removal, off-grid solar and off-grid water systems. The contractors quote and contract with the landowner directly under their own licence; the site does not perform, bid or supervise work. Requests for Tucson, Phoenix or anywhere outside Cochise County are not referred. The county-wide sister site is https://cochiselandmanagement.com.

The site also publishes guides for people living on or buying raw desert land in the valley: county permits, wells and the Willcox Active Management Area, caliche, septic, open range and lawful fence, ADUs and park models, off-grid solar sizing, hauled water, and a directory of local businesses a landowner actually needs (rock and sand yards, well drillers, pump suppliers, equipment dealers, the electric co-op). Every guide cites its sources and says what could not be confirmed.

## Service area — Sulphur Springs Valley, Cochise County, Arizona

Primary: Willcox, Cochise, Pearce, Sunsites, Dragoon, Kansas Settlement.
Extended: Bowie, San Simon, Elfrida, McNeal, Benson.

## Services (quoted and performed by referred ROC-licensed contractors)

- [Land clearing and brush removal](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/land-clearing): mesquite, creosote and overgrowth, building sites, firebreaks.
- [Bulk debris and trash removal](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/debris-removal): property cleanouts, construction waste, abandoned materials.
- [Grading, driveways and pad preparation](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/grading-driveways): building pads, driveways, access roads, drainage, compaction.
- [Trenching and earthwork](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/trenching-earthwork): utility and water-line trenches, foundation excavation, berms and swales.
- [Off-grid solar](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/solar-systems): installed by licensed Arizona solar contractors, who must provide the written warranty and certificate of compliance required by A.R.S. 44-1762.
- [Off-grid water systems](https://sulfurspringslandmanagement.com/services/water-systems): storage tanks, pump and pressure systems, filtration, plumbing.
